description: The bounds of a form and of an answer to it, and the typed refusal codes of the submit and save paths. social-service enforces them (apps/social-service/src/forms/answer-bounds.ts: the DTO validator, `submit`, the save checks) and the fill page announces them before anyone sends (frontend/src/lib/forms/answerBounds.ts: the textarea's `maxlength` and counter, the refusal sentences). Each side's spec asserts its constants equal these, so the two cannot drift apart. `maxQuestions` bounds both the questions a form may hold and the keys of one answer, so every form that can be saved can be answered in full; `maxGridRows` bounds a grid's rows at save and the keys of one grid answer.
